entities.summary: Krasimir Gaydarski or Krasimir Gajdarski is a Bulgarian male volleyball player. He was part of the Bulgaria men's national volleyball team. He competed with the national team at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing, China. He played with Olympiacos in 2008.
